# Version 4.147.0
> **Opens the v4 line** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147.0 opens the v4 line on Skia m147 with variable fonts and animated WebP encoding. It adds color font palettes, explicit sampling for surface draws, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. This preview also carries breaking engine, font, Vulkan, stream, WASM, and platform changes from the move beyond v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **SKFont() now uses SKTypeface.Empty** — A parameterless `SKFont` no longer resolves the platform default at draw time: its typeface is empty, measurements return zero, and text is not drawn. Construct it with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)` and use `font.Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of a null check. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint.Typeface and missing-family fallback semantics changed** — A new `SKPaint` now exposes `SKTypeface.Default` instead of null, and `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns the default face for missing families on every platform. Remove paint typeface null checks; use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when a missing family must return null. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) now validates the 32-bit native range** — The `long` overload is obsolete and throws `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating offsets outside the native 32-bit range. Validate the value and call `Move(int)`. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion types and layout changed** — `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`; the old `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` loses value equality, and the native layout replaces `FormatFeatures` while adding `Components` and filter fields. Update type references, comparisons, and manual interop initialization. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **WASM native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Blazor WASM and Uno Platform WASM projects targeting .NET 6 or .NET 7 now fail at build time; upgrade the WASM target to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets removed** — The Skia m147 transition removes the EOL Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move deployments to the new `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` assets. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Assembly version advanced to 4.x** — `SkiaSharp.dll` now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded version checks. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## Engine

- **Skia advances through m132, m133, and m147** — The bundled engine brings the v4 line current with upstream, including CICP color-space creation for H.273 and HDR workflows. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, named instances, typeface cloning, palette selection, and per-color overrides. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Bundled codec and font dependencies refreshed** — The release updates libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **SKSamplingOptions for surface draws** — `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` gain overloads that let callers choose filtering and mipmap behavior explicitly. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — `SKWebpEncoder` can encode a span of pixmap-and-duration frames into an animated WebP. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **SKStream.GetData() fast path** — Memory-backed streams can return their ref-counted `SKData` directly without copying; unsupported stream types return null. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New document, GPU, mask filter, and HarfBuzz APIs** — Adds XPS document options, per-resource GPU flushes, shader-backed mask filters, `HBColor`, and missing HarfBuzz wrappers. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Variable-font spans and glyph checks corrected** — Undersized variation buffers now report and copy the correct values, while `SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs` no longer recurses until a stack overflow. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — Disposal no longer flushes a builder after finalization begins, preventing a native crash when `SKPathBuilder` is collected before its `SKPath`. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface startup crash fixed** — Default face resolution moves to the managed font manager and falls back to `SKTypeface.Empty`, avoiding the Android API 36 null dereference. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))
- **Android SKGLView survives MAUI tab switches** — A reattached `SKGLView` starts its GL thread with the current dimensions instead of remaining on a zero-sized surface. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic native assets** — Dedicated x64 and arm64 `linux-bionic` binaries support Linux environments built on the Android NDK libc. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen gains x64 and arm64** — The package adds the official `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` runtime assets. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple target frameworks realigned** — Libraries target the base 26.0 Apple workloads while apps use unversioned TFMs, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

Adds variable-font shaping, color font palette APIs, and the `HBColor` value type, while extending native assets to Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.
